description: This file contains functions for handling platform-specific upgrade processes, image checks, and configuration copying for various network devices within the OpenWRT build system.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles device-specific upgrade procedures based on the board name, selecting the appropriate upgrade method such as FIT, Buffalo, NAND, or default.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs validation of the firmware image for the specific board, including magic number checks and platform-specific image validation.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration to the device during upgrade if certain conditions are met based on the board type, such as copying to eMMC storage.
